title: Head of Monitoring and Control
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

Build and lead the team owning the architecture, design, and integration of the facility-wide monitoring and control systems for Alpha, Proxima’s net energy gain stellarator. We are moving away from legacy industrial control paradigms towards a fully integrated control and observability platform. We are looking for a leader inspired by the cutting edge of robotics, autonomous vehicles, and modern aerospace avionics to lead this development. Pushing forwards the cutting edge of control, data, and monitoring capabilities for energy infrastructure, your role will span physical infrastructure, systems programming, real-time operations and scalable facility compute.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Specify mission control & supervisory software: Own the overarching supervisory control, telemetry pipelines, and live monitoring stack across Alpha and future Proxima facilities.

- Build the facility data center & data platform: Design, deploy, and scale the facility compute hardware and software data platform responsible for high-speed ingestion, streaming telemetry, storage, and live visualization.

- Drive functional safety strategy: Define the device-wide technical strategy for functional safety, collaborating directly with internal engineers and external regulatory stakeholders.

- Lead physical facility & environmental integration: Partner with facility teams to ensure physical services, cabling, and infrastructure support the I&C architecture under harsh radiation and magnetic field constraints.

- Drive hardware R&D: Identify R&D opportunities for control and automation hardware. Act as an expert customer to specify and co-design with external vendors.

- Standardize clean interface boundaries: Establish hardware and software interface standards across subsystems. Collaborate closely with system teams that own edge-level hardware and software.

 

WHO YOU ARE

- Exceptional execution & delivery leadership: Proven experience as a delivery or execution lead, selecting outstanding talent and building highly collaborative teams in a fast-moving environment. You excel at translating complex R&D into operational reality.

- A vision for modern control and data systems: Strong background working with safety and mission-critical software, combined with a vision to incorporate the best of modern software and AI into operational infrastructure.

- Lessons learnt in high-consequence engineering: Proven experience in high-performance sectors operating under strict performance and reliability constraints. Demonstrated track record in critical external customer, vendor, and stakeholder

title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - Nürnberg
description:
Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturierteres Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE

- Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu - telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

- Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

- Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

- Du planst deine Woche eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung).

- Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch - egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

- Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

- Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

- Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

- Du bist strukturiert und organisiert.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region - du startest nicht allein.

- Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

- Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: Von Junior- über Senior- und bis hin zu Führungsrollen..

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

- Teamevents, die den Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Team-Formate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Head of Security Engineering
description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role
DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and seasoned Head of Security Engineering to own the
security engineering strategy, roadmap, and delivery across our product platform and corporate environment.
Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will build and lead the Security Engineering team,
define its strategy and roadmap, and deliver improvements that support the security of customer data, the
firm’s growth, and regulatory obligations.
In this leadership role, you will provide both expert guidance on security and security capability
implementation across our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and
corporate technology. This role is focused on building and maturing the Security Engineering function and we
are seeking a leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on engineering experience to establish
scalable controls and enable product innovation. You will also lead the development and maintenance of
infrastructure, services, and automation for Security Operations, partnering with Engineering, IT, Risk, and
Compliance within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.
What You’ll Do
What You’ll Do
Strategy & Team Leadership

•
Roadmap Ownership: Define and deliver a multiyear security engineering strategy and quarterly roadmap across product and corporate environments, aligning architecture standards and investments with business priorities and risk appetite.

•
Team Leadership: Hire, coach, and develop a team of high-performing security engineers, manage performance, and build technical depth as the team scales.

•
Delivery & Risk Management: Manage backlogs, budgets, vendors, and dependencies. Work with Security GRC to measure control effectiveness and delivery. Communicate progress, tradeoffs, and residual risks to the CISO and technology leaders.

Product & Corporate Security

•
Product Security: Embed threat modeling, architecture reviews, security testing, and secure design into development and CI/CD, strengthening API authentication, authorization, data isolation, and secrets management.

•
Infrastructure Security: Secure AWS, including services such as EKS, EC2, DynamoDB, as well as co-located trading infrastructure through least privilege, segmentation, encryption, hardening, and automated guardrails, accounting for availability, recovery, and latency requirements.

•
Corporate Security: Partner with IT to mature identity, access governance, endpoint, remote access, DLP, communications, and SaaS security across the corporate service estate, including phishing-resistant authentication, device compliance, and data protection.

description:
Adobe Change Manager
London, hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

As Adobe Change and Adoption Manager you will support enterprise customer engagements. This individual will partner with Adobe delivery teams to design and execute organizational change management (OCM) strategies that drive adoption of Adobe Experience Cloud and Digital Media solutions, ensuring customers realize measurable value from their investment. You will work alongside Adobe consultants, solution architects, and customer stakeholders.

• Prosci certified.

title: AI Product Engineer - ClickStack
description:
Join us in building the AI layer for Observability!

ClickStack is the open-source observability platform we're building at ClickHouse - logs, metrics, traces, and session replays unified so engineers can find root causes quickly. The interesting work now is in the agent layer: systems that can investigate an incident at 2 AM, propose a root cause, and hand the on-call a concise summary by the time they've logged in.

We're hiring an AI Product Engineer to build agentic capabilities on top of a petabyte-scale observability platform, with a focus on developer experience. If you've been building agents, designing skills, and wiring up MCP servers - and you've hit the limits of generic copilots for production work - we'd like to talk.

What you'll do

- Build agents that investigate incidents. They surface anomalies, answer "why is production broken?", and use ClickStack as their substrate.

- Write skills, not just prompts. Build a library of reusable skills that captures how our team debugs, finds root causes, writes ClickHouse queries, and runs incident response, so agents pick up the right playbook instead of starting from scratch.

- Own the agent stack end-to-end. Context engineering, tool design, evals, tracing, cost. You're responsible for whether the agent works in production.

- Make ClickStack a great place to run AI workloads. Build the MCP servers, SDKs, and integrations that let customers' agents read telemetry, take action, and stay observable themselves.

- Work in the open. Collaborate with OSS contributors and customers, debug their problems alongside them, and feed what you learn back into the product.

- Tackle the hard parts. Latency, cost, context window limits, eval coverage, hallucinations on real telemetry.

Who you are

- You've been building agents long enough to have opinions - about context engineering, tool design, when to use a skill vs. a tool, what evals catch and miss, and where popular frameworks break down.

- You think in production terms: p99 latency, cost per task, whether the system still works next week without intervention.

- You move quickly, ship often, and learn from what breaks.

- You care about developer tools and have a clear sense of what good DX looks like.

- You do well with ambiguity and ownership.

What you bring

- 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 1-2 years on LLM-powered systems or agents in production.

- Strong backend skills in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python. Comfortable in both, even if one is primary.

- Hands-on experience building agents: multi-step tool use, planning, memory, error recovery. You've shipped them and dealt with the failure modes.

- Experience designing skills (Markdown-based workflow encodings, Anthropic-style or similar) and a clear view on when a skill, a tool, or both is the right fit.

- Experience with MCP: building servers, designing tools, and thinking through auth, scoping, and observability for agentic systems.

- Strong evals practice: golden sets, LLM-as-judge, regression detection.

- SQL proficiency - you can write ClickHouse queries directly.

- Comfort with Docker and Kubernetes.

- Active in open source and the developer community.

Bonus

- Built or operated production agents in observability, incident response, or SRE.

- Strong opinions on agent observability - tracing, cost attribution, eval pipelines, OpenTelemetry for agents - and ideas on how to improve it.

- Experience with prompt caching, context compaction, or other techniques relevant to running agents on production telemetry volumes.

- Experience with columnar databases and event ingestion pipelines.

- Contributed to or maintained an open source AI/agent project.

- Familiarity with Go, Rust, or other systems languages for integrations and high-throughput infra.

Ciroos is hiring a Technical Customer Success / Customer Program Manager to own the customer program from onboarding through adoption - connecting the dots across the customer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Product, and Engineering. You'll be the person making sure things don't fall through the cracks.

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Orchestration

• Own the customer program end-to-end from onboarding through adoption, tracking what needs to happen, who owns it, what's blocked, and what to prioritize next.

• Drive accountability across teams: when Engineering owes something, you drive it to closure; when Product needs to make a decision, you get it in front of them; when priorities compete, you help create clarity.

• Make sure Ciroos is delivering measurable value against what the customer actually cares about, not just what was scoped at kickoff.

• Partner with FDE and Engineering on technical questions, security/compliance reviews, and integration asks that surface mid-program, translating between customer language and internal owners in both directions.

title: Pricing and Monetization Manager
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

THE ROLE

Mercor produces all sorts of data of data types, for AI labs and enterprise customers. We're hiring someone to own pricing structures across our data types.

This person will build the pricing models, rate cards, and margin frameworks to ensure pricing is consistent and defensible.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Acquisition pricing & cost modeling (buy side)

- Establish fair market value for the data we buy - by data type, domain, and end buyer - and set the acquisition cost ceilings that bound what we'll pay

- Track competitor bidding behavior and maintain the cost curves that tell us when to pay up to win a corpus and when to walk

- Model fully-loaded cost to serve: acquisition price, extraction, human QC, anonymization/PII, and LLM inference - not just what we pay the vendor

- Define the priceable unit for each data type - per repo, per file, per video minute, per audio hour - and the quality attributes that move price within a unit

Monetization & margin strategy (sell side)

- Design pricing and packaging frameworks for data by data type, volume, format, and customer segment

- Build rate cards and tiered pricing for recurring, repeatable data products

- Own unit economics per deal and per data product, including transfer pricing, internal chargeback, and direct vs. indirect revenue attribution across account P&Ls

- Build the pricing/forecasting toolkit Finance and leadership use to evaluate new data products before launch

- Continuously test and refine pricing using win/loss data, renewal behavior, and market feedback

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 6+ years in pricing strategy, monetization, revenue operations, or a related analytical/strategy role - ideally at a data, marketplace, or B2B SaaS company

- Strong financial/quantitative modeling skills - fluent in Excel/Sheets; SQL a strong plus

- Track record of building pricing models from scratch, not just tuning ones already in place

- Comfortable operating with real ambiguity - public benchmarks for pricing data assets are thin, so structured judgment matters as much as data

- Sharp cross-functional communicator - this person works daily with Sourcing, Sales, Finance, and Product

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience pricing a two-sided marketplace (a cost/supply side and a demand/sell side), not just a single-sided product

- Background in AI training data, or market data

BENEFITS

- Bi-annual performance bonus structure

- Generous equity grant vested over 4 years

- Up to $15k Relocation bonus

- $10K proximity bonus (if you live within 0.5 miles of our office)

- $1.5K monthly stipend for meals

- Free Equinox membership

- $200 monthly laundry reimbursement

- $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement

- Health, Dental, Vision insurance

CWS builds and runs the security and cloud infrastructure companies depend on. • Hands-on AWS, and working knowledge of Azure or Google Cloud: identity, networking, compute, storage, logging.

title: Cyber Security Fraud Analyst
description:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.
As a Senior Cybersecurity Fraud Analyst, you will use your expertise in data analysis, financial transactions, and web traffic analysis to identify and investigate potential fraudulent activities within our hCaptcha SaaS security platform.
Your primary responsibilities will include conducting advanced investigations into complex fraud patterns, developing actionable insights to enhance our fraud detection capabilities, and collaborating with machine learning teams to continuously improve our AI/ML detection and response systems.
Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.

What will you do:

• Monitor, identify, and analyze events from diverse data sources, including financial transactions and web traffic, to detect and respond to fraudulent activities.

• Conduct advanced investigations of suspected fraud, analyzing behavior patterns and anomalies to assess risk and determine appropriate actions.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Product, Customer Support, to enhance fraud detection and prevention strategies.

• Help build and align fraud detection automation, dashboards, and reports.

• Continuously audit and refine fraud detection measures to ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices.

• Stay informed of emerging fraud trends, technologies, and regulatory changes to keep our fraud prevention strategies up-to-date.

What we are looking for:

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in fraud detection, financial data analysis, risk management, or trust & safety.

• Proficiency in SQL and ideally Python for data analysis and visualization.

• In-depth understanding of fraud detection methodologies and the fraud landscape.

• Ability to work with large datasets and derive actionable insights.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, with a detail-oriented and analytical mindset.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, able to work effectively across teams.

• Familiarity with the analysis of web-based and API abuse.

Nice to Have:

• Hands-on experience with web security and secure configuration practices.

• Interest in staying current with industry trends and fraud prevention technologies.

• Familiarity with modern fraud machine learning practices.

• Holding a valid CFE, CFS, CFF, or CISA certification is a plus.

What do we offer:

• Fully remote position with flexible working hours.

• An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.

• Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.

• High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting-edge R&D.

• Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!
Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer - US Government
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) understand our customers’ greatest pain points and design end-to-end solutions to address them. FDSEs solicit constant feedback on their work from both customers and colleagues, improving our products over time with rapid iteration cycles.

FDSEs deploy ground breaking technical solutions to solve our customers’ hardest problems. Projects often start with a nebulous question like “Why are we losing customers?” or “How can we more effectively identify instances of money laundering?” FDSEs lead the way in developing a solution, from high-level system design and prototyping to application development and data integration. As an FDSE, you leverage everything around you: Palantir products, open source technologies, and anything you and your team can build to drive real impact.

You work with customers around the globe, where you gain rare insight into the world’s most important industries and institutions. We help our customers detect insider trading, improve disaster relief, fight healthcare fraud, and more. Each mission presents different challenges, from the regulatory environment to the nature of the data to the user population. You will work to accommodate all aspects of an environment to drive real technical outcomes for our customers.

Whether you aspire to be an entrepreneur or an engineering leader, we believe Palantir is the best place - with the best colleagues - to learn how. You’ll learn how to unpack a problem and understand the costs and consequences of its solution. You’ll learn new technologies and languages, and even develop them yourself. title: Head of Support Engineering
description:
ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike. We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll build and lead Support at Exa: an AI-first, 24/7 support function for every committed customer, worldwide. AI tools like Pylon and AI agents handle the first line; your team of Support Engineers takes on the hard technical problems the AI can't, with the same technical depth as our Forward Deployed Engineers.

You'll also own escalation management: watching the health of every account, largely through AI, and making sure every contraction or churn risk reaches the right people with a clear plan to fix it.

This is a technical leadership role. You hold the same technical bar as your team: you can debug a customer integration, read the code, and open a pull request yourself.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Build the Support team: hire, onboard and lead Support Engineers across regions for 24/7, follow-the-sun coverage

- Build the support system: own our Pylon setup, ticket and SLA tracking, severity levels, automations and the end-of-shift handoffs, so the function runs as efficiently as possible

- Make the AI first line work: decide which tickets the AI resolves and which reach a human, and keep improving the share it resolves without a person

- Own escalations to Engineering: a clear path with full context, and customer follow-up owned by Support until resolution

- Own escalation management: monitor account health across regions, flag every contraction or churn risk to the account team and leadership with requested actions and owners, and follow it until resolved. Escalation management is a duty of your Support Engineers; add dedicated people only if the load requires it

- Partner with the account team (AEs, account managers, FDEs) on at-risk and strategic accounts

- Turn ticket patterns into product feedback, and drive fixes with Product and Engineering

- Report on support health: response and resolution times, customer satisfaction, AI resolution rate, and churn and contraction avoided

REQUIREMENTS

- Several years of hands-on programming experience, at the same level as the Support Engineers you'll hire: you can debug APIs and customer integrations and open pull requests yourself

- 5+ years in technical support, support engineering, SRE or customer engineering, including 2+ years leading a technical support team, ideally at an API, developer-tools or AI company

- Experience building support operations from scratch: tooling, SLAs, severity models, escalation paths and 24/7 coverage

- Strong judgment on automation and AI: you've used AI or automation to scale a support function without lowering quality

- Clear communication with customers, engineers and executives, especially under pressure

YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU...

- Have built or rebuilt a support function at a fast-growing technical company

- Have run Pylon, or a similar support platform, at scale

- Have built with LLMs, RAG or agents

- Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employe

title: Director, National Accounts - Government
description:
Job title : Director, National Accounts - Government

•
Location: Remote, US

About the Job
Sanofi Vaccines is seeking an exceptional, senior executive to serve as the strategic face of our organization to the United States federal government health ecosystem. The Director, National Accounts - Government is one of the most strategically significant and complex commercial roles within Sanofi 's entire portfolio - responsible for leading executive engagement, contract strategy, and revenue growth across a the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA). This role demands rare expertise at the intersection of federal procurement, public health policy, and high-stakes relationship management at the highest levels of the U.S. government.

The federal government health ecosystem presents a level of complexity unmatched in the commercial marketplace. This role requires mastery of federal acquisition regulations (FAR), agency-specific contract vehicles, Made in America requirements, and evolving cybersecurity mandates such as CMMC - all while navigating multi-layered decision-making structures that span clinical, administrative, and procurement stakeholders across VA Regions, Veterans Integrated Service Networks (VISNs), VA Medical Centers (VAMCs), and the full DHA command structure. Success demands deep technical expertise in government contracting and sustained relationship capital to influence outcomes at the most senior levels of federal health leadership.

The Director, National Accounts - Government will be the lead executer of strategies designed to capture the potential in market - advancing immunization rates across all agencies, and positioning Sanofi as the undisputed preferred vaccine partner within the federal health ecosystem.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.
About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system - and innovative pipeline - enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.
Main Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Market Development

• Lead executive strategy and engagement across the Veterans Affairs (VA), Defense Health Agency (DHA).

• Build and maintain comprehensive influence maps across the full federal health ecosystem - from national agency leadership to regional and local levels, including VA Regions, VISNs, and VAMCs, as well as within DHA.

• Lead RFP strategy development and response delivery for federal contract opportunities, ensuring competitive positioning and compliance with all applicable federal requirements.

• Identify, develop, and capture growth opportunities across all products in the portfolio across the federal health ecosystem.

• Develop and implement data-driven interventions to close immunization coverage gaps and advance vaccination rates across VA & DHA. Cross collaboration with the various Agencies Innovation Divisions and Sanofi BARDA Team, Specialty and General Meds Teams, is critical.

Executive Relationship Management

• Cultivate and sustain C-Suite and Key Opinion Leader relationships at the highest levels of the VA & DHA- including agency heads, procurement leaders, senior clinical leadership, and other decision makers.

• Engage and coordinate across the full spectrum of multi-layered federal decision-making structures, ensuring Sanofi maintains sustained influence at every level of the government health hierarchy.

• Serve as Sanofi 's primary commercial executive liaison to federal government health agencies, representing the full breadth and depth of the Sanofi Vaccines portfolio.

Federal Contracting
